find_yield_pools.description: Search 16,000+ yield pools by chain, project, token, APY and size. Each result separates the base APY from the reward APY (rewards are paid in incentive tokens and can stop) and carries the 30-day mean, so a spot rate can be checked against a steadier one. Setting a minimum TVL is worth doing on any search: the highest raw APYs belong to pools holding a few hundred dollars.
find_yield_pools.name: find_yield_pools

description: Read DeFi's open dataset from DefiLlama: the TVL of every protocol and chain it tracks, with the history behind it; token prices by contract address, including tokens too small to be listed elsewhere, with historical, first-recorded and interval-sampled series and the block nearest any moment; stablecoin supply, prices and peg drift, per asset and per chain; 16,000+ yield pools searchable by chain, project, token and APY, with each pool's history; and the volume, open interest, fees and revenue of DEXs, options venues and perpetual exchanges. No account or API key is required.
